question: Where has Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis announced the Southeast Asia’s Largest Pilot Training Institute?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amravati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the Amravati Airport and announced that the city will host Southeast Asia’s largest pilot training institute.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Flying Training Organisation (FTO) in Amravati will train 180 pilots annually using 34 aircraft.**
 
• It will be the largest pilot training institute in Southeast Asia with a projected capacity to train 30,000 pilots.
 
• The institute is expected to enhance economic activity and create jobs in the Vidarbha region.
 
• **Amravati Airport was inaugurated along with a new flight route between Amravati and Mumbai under UDAN scheme.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Amravati**__

 __
 
• Located in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra.
 
• Now home to a newly inaugurated airport and the upcoming major aviation training centre.
 
 
 
• **UDAN Scheme**__
 __
 
• Launched to enhance regional air connectivity.
 
• Stands for "Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik".
 
 
 
• **Devendra Fadnavis**__
 
 
• Currently serving as Maharashtra's Chief Minister.
 
• Announced multiple aviation development projects in Vidarbha.
